definitions.gloss: splitting the bill; going Dutch; sharing the cost equally
definitions.explanation: dividing a bill equally among the people paying

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{割|わ}り{勘|かん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Is it okay to split the bill?

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{割|わ}り{勘|かん}だ。
examples.english: We always split the bill when eating with friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧{三千円|さんぜんえん}⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{割|わ}り{勘|かん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: We split it and each paid 3,000 yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦デート→デート：03861_deeto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{割|わ}り{勘|かん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧。
examples.english: Whether to split the bill on a date depends on the person.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{割|わ}り⟦{勘定|かんじょう}→勘定：02582_kanjou⟧ (divided bill) → {割|わ}り{勘|かん}

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {割|わ}り{勘|かん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to split the bill)
- {割|わ}り{勘|かん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay by splitting)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦おごる→おごる：08157_ogoru⟧ (to treat someone)
- ⟦{別々|べつべつ}→別々：03972_betsubetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay separately)
- ⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay together)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {割|わ}り{勘|かん} is common among friends and casual dining. However, in business or more formal settings, the senior person or host often pays. On dates, customs vary by generation and personal preference.
